original_title: StyleTune - SIGGRAPH Appy Hour - This Thursday Live
original_content_full:
StyleTune - SIGGRAPH Appy Hour - This Thursday Live

The Appy Hour will go live on Thursday, 7 p.m. CET ! Join the presentation and Q&A follow up to learn more about how StyleTune enables you to create stunning artwork with controllable Neural Style Transfer. As a sneak peak you can already check out our presentation video here: 
https://youtu.be/dw-e2TzYClg

If you want to get more detailed technical information, you can also check out our project website for the Cyberworlds conference here: https://ivpg.hpi3d.de/styletune/
